lesson: The QA handoff comment must carry: (1) PR url and merge sha, (2) deployed-to-QA confirmation with the dbt Cloud run id, (3) the 7-col validation matrix or recon table, (4) explicit @-mention of the requester (resolved via slack_directory.json). Without (4), the requester sometimes misses the handoff entirely.
evidence: User had to manually nudge me to re-ping <person> after the EDAEM-3772 RCA was posted because no @-mention was included.

lesson: Posts a Jira status comment as an ADF table with: PR url + merge sha, CD run id + deployed-to-QA confirmation, the 7-col ValidationMatrix (or recon table when --quarter-close was set), and @-mentions of every uid in notify_user_ids resolved against slack_directory.json. Optionally transitions the ticket to 'Ready for QA'. Pauses before posting in any auth mode != FULL_AUTO. Attaches pytest junit.xml + dbt target/ output when available.

For refactor / PVQ-recon tickets, the QA-handoff comment MUST attach the side-by-side PVQ-vs-QA-vs-Prod recon table at the test-fixture agreement grain (a1X4X000007UyvvUAC and any other agreement_ids from the requirements spec). The acceptable tolerance is ZERO row-count drift for `ssr_off_cycle_arr`, `ssr_up_for_renewal_arr`, and any other named-bucket ARR category; cosmetic differences (sub-penny rounding, array ordering) can be called out as 'no action needed'.
evidence: Refactored QA / UAT Testing - recurring pattern of 3-way recon table requirements.

lesson: `qa-handoff` has failed before with: "jira-intake produced no ticket payload". Before re-running, confirm upstream inputs and any required env/secrets (JIRA_*, DBT Cloud token, slack channel id) are populated.
evidence: qa-handoff returned `fail` in run for EDAEM-3723: jira-intake produced no ticket payload.

lesson: VALIDATION RULE (three-way IA tie-out): The tester must validate the IA code end-to-end by comparing the full source-to-output chain: Salesforce (system of record) vs Snowflake BASE_PROD (raw Fivetran-landed source) vs FINANCE_PROD (IA aggregations/output). Reconcile in order: Salesforce -> BASE_PROD (ingestion parity) -> FINANCE_PROD (transformation parity against the IA code). Do NOT validate against legacy certified_* baselines - the baseline is the SFDC -> BASE_PROD -> FINANCE_PROD chain.
evidence: Explicit user directive 2026-07-07 (fqc-arr scoping + validation rules).
